headline: UCSB Dining Commons Hours: Carrillo, DLG, Portola & Ortega
description: How UCSB dining commons hours work: typical meal windows at all four commons, weekend differences, and how to check before you walk.

mainEntity.name: What are the UCSB dining commons?

acceptedAnswer.text: UCSB has four dining commons: Carrillo, De La Guerra (DLG), Portola, and Ortega. Each serves different meal windows that change by quarter, weekends, and breaks.

mainEntity.name: Are UCSB dining commons open on weekends?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but with reduced service — fewer halls, shorter windows, and brunch-style scheduling at some commons. Check the current day's hours before walking over.

mainEntity.name: How do I check UCSB dining hours and menus quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: UCSB Dining publishes current hours and menus, and the Lagoon app shows live menus for all four commons in one view.
